sourceDescription: ESA (1997), The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200; CDS VizieR I/239/hip_main
propagation: Linear tangent-vector proper motion from J1991.25 to the requested epoch. No radial velocities/perspective acceleration, relativistic aberration, binary orbital motion, or variable-star light curves.
distanceMethod: 1000/parallax(mas) parsecs only for positive parallax with signal-to-noise >=5. Otherwise null; do not invent a distance.

spectralClassification.catalogue: ESA 1997, Hipparcos Main Catalogue, CDS I/239/hip_main
spectralClassification.field: SpType (H76), with r_SpType (H77) preserved in sidecar
spectralClassification.classificationMethod: Leading O/B/A/F/G/K/M letter in the catalogue SpType text, allowing the explicit sd subdwarf prefix. Composite and uncertain types retain their complete original text; the displayed broad class is their leading reported class. Other reported spectral types are other. Blank types are unknown. Nothing is inferred from B-V.

sourceFlagMeaning.K: General Catalogue of Variable Stars, 4th edition

spectralClassification.note: SpType values are catalogued classifications compiled from spectroscopy/literature, not spectral measurements made by the Hipparcos astrometric mission. B-V is a separate observed photometric colour index.
spectralClassification.spectralTypeText: Not shipped: the spectralType column is null; the complete SpType text is in research/live/hipparcos-spectral-types.json.

propagationDetails.method: normalize(u0 + dt * (pmRA * e_RA + pmDE * e_Dec) * radians_per_milliarcsecond)
propagationDetails.pmRAConvention: pmRA is mu_alpha*cos(delta), used directly along the unit RA tangent; do not divide by cos(delta).
propagationDetails.limitations: Linear tangent-vector astrometric propagation, consistent with previous snapshot. No radial velocity or perspective acceleration, annual parallax, aberration, precession rotation of the ICRS frame, binary orbital motion, or evolving magnitudes. Catalogue parallax distances retained. The periodic millisecond TT/TDB difference is negligible at 10-decimal vector precision and is omitted.

subset: V <= 4.6 or distance < 120 pc, taken from the 41394-star V <= 8 catalogue
